verdict.rationale: Bitwarden publishes a first-party MCP server (bitwarden/mcp-server, GPL-3.0, on npm). A runtime probe confirmed that `npx -y @bitwarden/mcp-server` completed a full stdio initialize handshake and identified itself as 'Bitwarden MCP Server' v2026.7.0. Missing for 10: documentation of the tools and vault operations the server exposes to agents, and independent community reports of real agent use beyond the handshake.
